Under legacy semantics, the default `"auto"` resolves to `"multiindex"`, and explicitly choosing `"multiindex"` likewise leaves `flat_snapshots` false. `create_model` still obtains `sns` through the unchanged `as_index` call and passes that same `sns` to the variable and constraint builders; the new context does not flatten component data in this case. Changes inside builders do not change which snapshots `create_model` hands them.
